ops.en: to fit, stick, or hold together, or to form a logically consistent whole
ops.cn: 黏合；连贯；形成逻辑一致的整体

ops.note: Rare causative wording is lower priority.

ops.en: happening by chance or coincidence rather than because of a causal connection
ops.cn: 巧合的；偶然同时发生而无因果联系的

ops.en: to collect and arrange information, pages, or other items in the proper order
ops.cn: 整理、核对并按顺序排列（资料、页面等）

ops.note: Scholarly sense: compare texts or versions critically.

ops.en: to establish or settle a colony in a place
ops.cn: 建立殖民地；移民定居

ops.en: to establish colonial control over a territory or people
ops.cn: 对某地或人群建立殖民统治

ops.en: to establish and grow a population in a habitat, surface, or part of an organism
ops.cn: （生物/生态）定殖；在栖息地、体表或机体部位建立种群

boundaries.note: British spelling of the same verb.

ops.en: deserving praise or approval
ops.cn: 值得赞扬的；可嘉的

ops.meaning_cn: 就某事向某人表示同情、慰问

ops.en: combining well with something because each supplies qualities or parts that the other lacks
ops.cn: 互补的；相辅相成的

ops.boundary: complementary = completing or matching well; complimentary = praising or free of charge. They are distinct lexemes, not spelling variants.

ops.en: the natural color, tone, or general appearance of the skin, especially on the face
ops.cn: 肤色；尤指面部皮肤的颜色和状态

ops.en: the general character, nature, or aspect of a situation or subject
ops.cn: （局势、问题等的）性质、面貌、特征

ops.value: complimentary = praising or free of charge; complementary = completing or matching well. Distinct lexemes.

ops.definition_en: to be consistent or compatible with something
to consist of or be made up of parts or members

ops.en: difficult to control because driven by a strong repeated urge or compulsion
ops.cn: 难以控制的；受强烈反复冲动驱使的
ops.usage_note: The adjective does not by itself imply a diagnosis of OCD.

ops.note: Noun use for a person is secondary and often context-sensitive.

ops.en: the process or result of ending disagreement and restoring goodwill or cooperation
ops.cn: 调解；和解；恢复友好关系的过程或结果

ops.en: a process of helping parties settle a dispute without a more formal adjudication
ops.cn: 争议调解；通过协商等方式促成争端解决

ops.en: to invent or fabricate a story, excuse, plan, or scheme, often cleverly or deceptively
ops.cn: 编造（故事、借口）；策划、炮制（计划）

ops.en: to agree or share the same opinion
ops.cn: 同意；意见一致

ops.note: Formal sense: happen at the same time.

ops.en: agreement or accord in opinion, judgment, or result
ops.cn: 一致；同意；意见相合

ops.en: the occurrence or operation of events or circumstances together or at the same time
ops.cn: 同时发生；并存；共同作用

ops.note: Cooperation is a context-dependent extension, not the sole Core.

ops.en: providing favorable conditions that make a particular result more likely or easier
ops.cn: 有助于……的；为某结果提供有利条件的

ops.meaning_cn: 信任某人并向其吐露秘密或私事

ops.en: evidence, action, or a result that confirms or verifies that something is true, correct, or settled
ops.cn: 确认；证实；用于验证某事真实、正确或已确定的证据/行为

ops.en: a message or record showing that a booking, order, registration, or arrangement has been accepted
ops.cn: 确认信息；订单、预订或登记已被接受的确认记录

ops.note: Religious confirmation/coming-of-age ceremonies are tradition-specific, not the generic Core.

ops.en: to officially take or seize property, especially by legal authority or as a penalty
ops.cn: 没收；充公；依法扣押财物

ops.en: to prove an expectation, prediction, critic, or assumption wrong, often by an unexpected result
ops.cn: 使预期、预测或批评落空；出乎意料地证明其错误

ops.meaning_cn: 使预期、预测或批评落空

ops.en: pleasant, friendly, or well suited to a person's tastes, character, or needs
ops.cn: 令人愉快的；友好的；合意的、适合的

ops.en: overcrowded, blocked, or excessively full, as with traffic, networks, airways, blood vessels, the nose, or chest
ops.cn: 拥堵的；阻塞的；也指鼻腔、胸部或血管等充血/堵塞

ops.note: Business conglomerate: a group of diverse companies under common ownership.

ops.en: a collection or mass made up of varied and different elements
ops.cn: 由多种不同成分组成的混合体、集合体

ops.en: a sedimentary rock made of rounded fragments cemented together
ops.cn: 砾岩；由圆磨碎屑胶结形成的沉积岩

ops.en: a guess, theory, or conclusion formed from incomplete evidence
ops.cn: 猜测；推测；基于不完整证据形成的判断

ops.en: to form or express a guess or theory from incomplete evidence
ops.cn: 推测；猜测

ops.en: to summon or produce something as if by magic
ops.cn: 用魔法召唤；仿佛凭空变出

ops.pattern: conjure sth up / conjure up sth
ops.meaning_cn: 使某个形象、记忆、想法等浮现；想象出
ops.definition_en: to bring an image, memory, idea, or situation vividly to mind or create it imaginatively

ops.note: Older sense meaning entreat/request earnestly is not learner-main.

ops.en: to imply or suggest an additional meaning, feeling, or association beyond the literal meaning
ops.cn: 意味着；暗含；联想到（字面意义之外的附加意义或情感）

ops.value: connote = imply associated or additional meaning; denote = directly indicate or literally mean.

ops.en: to make something sacred by a religious ceremony or formally dedicate it to a sacred purpose
ops.cn: 祝圣；通过宗教仪式使……神圣或奉献于神圣用途

ops.en: to formally dedicate a person, place, object, or effort to a particular purpose
ops.cn: 正式奉献、投入于某一目的

ops.en: to deliver or entrust a person or thing to another person, place, or authority for care, custody, sale, or handling
ops.cn: 交付；托付；把人或物交给某人/某地处理或保管

ops.en: to send goods or other items to a destination or recipient
ops.cn: 发送、托运（货物等）

ops.meaning_cn: 使某人/某物被遗忘、成为历史或落入某种命运
与某人来往、结交，常含贬义

ops.note: Royal consort: spouse of a reigning monarch.

ops.en: of events, circumstances, or conditions: to combine so as to cause a result, often one that frustrates a plan or works against someone
ops.cn: （事件、环境、条件）共同作用而造成某结果，常指不利结果

ops.meaning_cn: 各种情况/事件共同作用导致某事发生

ops.en: a limitation or restriction on what can be done, such as time, budget, resource, legal, or physical limits
ops.cn: 限制条件；约束，如时间、预算、资源、法律或物理限制

ops.note: Physical restraint is one narrower branch.
Force/control branch is narrower than the general limitation sense.

ops.meaning_cn: 把某事解释、理解为某种含义

ops.en: the transmission or spread of an infectious disease from one person or organism to another
ops.cn: 传染；感染性疾病的传播

ops.note: Figurative spread of emotions, attitudes, or behavior.

ops.en: disagreement, dispute, or conflict over an issue
ops.cn: 争论；争议；分歧

ops.meaning_cn: 争议焦点；引起争论的问题

ops.note: Also a claim or point asserted as part of an argument.
